payload.name: mcp-test-config
payload.description: mcp-test CLI after l65-wiring (br1 FTD leg as {{fw_*}} variables) and the w8-live VPN 10 conversion (Gi3 in mcp-w8-vpn10-lan)

data.config:
system
 overlay-id            1
 ipv6-strict-control   false
 port-offset           0
 admin-tech-on-failure
 sp-organization-name  mcp-lab-org
 organization-name     mcp-lab-org
 console-baud-rate     9600
 no on-demand enable
 on-demand idle-timeout 10
 vbond 10.60.2.11 port 12346
!
memory free low-watermark processor 226892
service timestamps debug datetime msec
service timestamps log datetime msec
no service tcp-small-servers
no service udp-small-servers
platform console serial
platform qfp utilization monitor load 80
platform sslvpn use-pd
username admin privilege 15 secret 9 <redacted>
vrf definition 10
 rd 1:10
 address-family ipv4
  exit-address-family
 !
!
vrf definition Mgmt-intf
 address-family ipv4
  exit-address-family
 !
!
ip arp proxy disable
no ip domain lookup
ip forward-protocol nd
no ip ftp passive
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 10.60.1.254
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 10.60.2.254
ip route vrf Mgmt-intf 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 192.0.2.254
ip route vrf 10 {{fw_route}}
ip scp server enable
ip bootp server
no ip source-route
no ip ssh bulk-mode
ip tcp RST-count 10 RST-window 5000
ip http server
ip http secure-server
ip nat settings central-policy
ip nat settings gatekeeper-size 1024
ipv6 unicast-routing
ipv6 rip vrf-mode enable
cdp run
interface GigabitEthernet1
 description mpls transport
 no shutdown
 ip address {{mpls_ip}} 255.255.255.0
 negotiation auto
exit
interface GigabitEthernet2
 description inet transport
 no shutdown
 ip address {{inet_ip}} 255.255.255.0
 negotiation auto
exit
interface GigabitEthernet4
 description management (VPN 512)
 no shutdown
 vrf forwarding Mgmt-intf
 ip address {{mgmt_ip}} 255.255.192.0
 negotiation auto
exit
interface {{fw_if}}
 description {{fw_if_desc}}
 {{fw_if_state}}
 vrf forwarding 10
 ip address {{fw_ip_mask}}
exit
interface Tunnel1
 no shutdown
 ip unnumbered GigabitEthernet1
 tunnel source GigabitEthernet1
 tunnel mode sdwan
exit
interface Tunnel2
 no shutdown
 ip unnumbered GigabitEthernet2
 tunnel source GigabitEthernet2
 tunnel mode sdwan
exit
control-plane
!
clock timezone UTC 0 0
no logging rate-limit
no logging queue-limit
aaa authentication login default local
aaa authorization console
aaa authorization exec default local
aaa server radius dynamic-author
!
login on-success log
redundancy
!
vtp mode server
radius-server cache expiry 24
no crypto ikev2 diagnose error
fhrp version vrrp v3
line aux 0
 stopbits 1
!
line con 0
 speed    9600
 stopbits 1
!
line vty 0 4
 activation-character 13
 transport input ssh
!
line vty 5 80
 transport input ssh
!
no process cpu extended history
lldp run
nat64 translation timeout tcp 3600
nat64 translation timeout udp 300
sdwan
 interface GigabitEthernet1
  tunnel-interface
   encapsulation ipsec
   color mpls
   allow-service all
   no allow-service bgp
   allow-service dhcp
   allow-service dns
   allow-service icmp
   no allow-service sshd
   no allow-service netconf
   no allow-service ntp
   no allow-service ospf
   no allow-service stun
   allow-service https
   no allow-service snmp
   no allow-service bfd
  exit
 exit
 interface GigabitEthernet2
  tunnel-interface
   encapsulation ipsec
   color biz-internet
   allow-service all
   no allow-service bgp
   allow-service dhcp
   allow-service dns
   allow-service icmp
   no allow-service sshd
   no allow-service netconf
   no allow-service ntp
   no allow-service ospf
   no allow-service stun
   allow-service https
   no allow-service snmp
   no allow-service bfd
  exit
 exit
 appqoe
  no tcpopt enable
  no dreopt enable
  no httpopt enable
 !
 omp
  no shutdown
  send-path-limit  4
  ecmp-limit       4
  graceful-restart
  no as-dot-notation
  timers
   holdtime               300
   advertisement-interval 1
   graceful-restart-timer 43200
   eor-timer              300
  exit
  address-family ipv4
   advertise connected
   advertise static
   distance 251
  !
  address-family ipv6
   advertise connected
   advertise static
   distance 251
  !
 !
!
bfd default-dscp 48
bfd app-route multiplier 6
bfd app-route poll-interval 600000
sslproxy
 no enable
 rsa-key-modulus      2048
 certificate-lifetime 730
 eckey-type           P256
 ca-tp-label          PROXY-SIGNING-CA
 settings expired-certificate  drop
 settings untrusted-certificate drop
 settings unknown-status       drop
 settings certificate-revocation-check none
 settings unsupported-protocol-versions drop
 settings unsupported-cipher-suites drop
 settings failure-mode         close
 settings minimum-tls-ver      TLSv1
 dual-side optimization enable
!
banner motd #{{banner_motd}}#
